meta_description: Gold Decorating Ltd brings expert interior and exterior painting to Leeds homes. Professional finishes, reliable service, free quotes. Call 07533 886104.
hero_subhead: Expert interior and exterior painting across Leeds. Bright, lasting finishes that transform your rooms without the mess.
services_subhead: From single-room refreshes to full house transformations, Gold Decorating handles interior repaints, exterior cladding, and everything in between.

services.title: Interior Wall & Ceiling Painting
services.desc: Fresh paint that brings new life to your lounge, bedroom, or kitchen. We prep surfaces properly and use premium finishes for a smooth, long-lasting result.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with quality exterior paint. We handle fascias, soffits, doors, and walls to protect and refresh your property's kerb appeal.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, window frames, and built-in cupboards deserve expert attention. We strip, prepare, and finish wood to a high standard.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert paper hanging for a professional finish, or swift removal of old paper. We prepare walls properly so new paper sits flat and lasts.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Feature walls, textured coatings, and decorative paint effects. Create a room with real character using techniques tailored to your vision.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Offices, retail spaces, and rental properties need reliable, quick turnarounds. We work flexibly around your business schedule.

about_pullquote: A fresh coat of paint shouldn't mean chaos in your home. We get it right first time.
about_para_1: Gold Decorating was founded in 2006 by a Leeds painter frustrated with poor standards in the trade. Over nearly two decades, we've built our reputation on clean, reliable work and transparent pricing. Every project — whether a quick bedroom refresh or a full house redecoration — gets the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers come back to us because we turn up on time, protect your furniture and flooring, and deliver a finish that looks great for years. We're based in Harehills and know Leeds inside out — from Victorian terraces to modern estates. When you ring us, you speak to someone who understands your home's needs.
